response.query: Which DFT functionals, dispersion corrections, basis sets, software versions, and DLPNO‑CCSD(T) / relativistic/SOC corrections will we standardize for geometry optimizations and spectroscopy benchmarking?
response.answer: For benchmarking, we will standardize B3LYP-D3, 6-311+G(d,p) basis set, ORCA software, and DLPNO-CCSD(T) for spectroscopy. Relativistic and SOC corrections will be applied as needed.
